cases.name: a-sample-read-as-a-distribution
cases.description: The file is ten whole ages, sorted once and treated as a ruler; a row lands anywhere on it and takes the value between two neighbours. The answer is whole because the SOURCE is whole — the file's own precision decides, not a guess.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="ages" local="en"><sequence name="OUT"><gen type="file" src="sample-ages.txt" read="quantile"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{OUT}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-money-sample-keeps-its-cents
cases.description: The same read over amounts written to the cent. Nothing is declared: two decimal places in, two decimal places out.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="money" local="en"><sequence name="OUT"><gen type="file" src="sample-amounts.txt" read="quantile"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{OUT}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: decimals-overrides-the-source-precision
cases.description: A whole-number sample asked for three places gives the interpolated value itself, unrounded — which is what makes the interpolation visible in a fixture.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="ages" local="en"><sequence name="OUT"><gen type="file" src="sample-ages.txt" read="quantile" decimals="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{OUT}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: the-exact-sweep-covers-the-distribution
cases.description: sample="exact" throws no dice: row i takes slot permute(i, count, key) and reads probability (slot + 0.5) / count, so the run sweeps the sample instead of drawing from it. The column is scattered rather than sorted, and every engine lands on the same scatter.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="sweep" local="en"><sequence name="OUT"><gen type="file" src="sample-ages.txt" read="quantile" sample="exact"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{OUT}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: the-exact-sweep-over-money
cases.description: The same sweep over the amounts file, so the two precisions are pinned on both paths.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="sweep" local="en"><sequence name="OUT"><gen type="file" src="sample-amounts.txt" read="quantile" sample="exact" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{OUT}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-plain-read-of-the-same-file-still-picks-whole-values
cases.description: The contrast that gives the feature its reason: read the same file the ordinary way and only the values written in it can ever come out, however many rows are asked for — seven of the file's eight distinct values here, and 41 more often than the rest because the file holds it three times. That is the file's own shape and it is correct; what it cannot do is produce anything in between.
